# `ocir-push.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| allow_fork_prs | Allow fork PRs to run this workflow (set false for self-hosted runners) | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| build_args | Docker build arguments (newline-separated KEY=VALUE pairs) | `string` | `` | no |
| docker_context | Docker build context | `string` | `.` | no |
| dockerfile_path | Path to Dockerfile | `string` | `./Dockerfile` | no |
| image_name | Name of the Docker image | `string` | n/a | yes |
| platforms | Platforms to build for (comma-separated) | `string` | `linux/amd64,linux/arm64` | no |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array (e.g., ["self-hosted", "oke"]) | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04"]` | no |
| tag_version | Tag image with version from VERSION file and latest (default: only commit SHA) | `boolean` | `false` | no |
| version_file | Path to VERSION file | `string` | `./VERSION` | no |

## Secrets

| Name | Description | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :------: |
| oci_namespace | OCIR Namespace | yes |
| oci_registry | OCI Registry URL (e.g., iad.ocir.io) | yes |
| oci_token | OCI Auth Token | yes |
| oci_username | OCI Username | yes |

## Outputs

| Name | Description |
| :--- | :---------- |
| image_tags | Full image tags that were built |
| version | Version read from VERSION file |
